description: Joieuse is a refreshing new take on skincare using sustainably-sourced natural ingredients made in the USA and never tested on animals. Our selling proposition revolves around educating customers on the unique ingredients we use, and offering exceptional value for our product quality. Our core product lines include facial cleansers, facial toners, moisturizers, and mineral based sunscreens free of any chemicals that are harmful for our skin or the environment. Our skincare line is effective for all skin types, but works particularly well for people with sensitive skin. Beyond standard daily care lines, we also develop unique serum and cream formulations for skin brightening, anti-aging, and blemish control. All Joieuse orders ship free via an expedited service level, typically arriving within 3 business days of purchase. We also offer free returns within 30 days.

Welcome to the Joieuse family of affiliates, and thank you for joining our Affiliate program ("Program").

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program ("Affiliate" or "Affiliates") to refer customers to purchase products or services from Joieuse (the "Merchant").

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.


1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

The Merchant reserves the right to approve or reject ANY affiliate Program registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your affiliate Program registration.


2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Your affiliate link is automatically generated, but you may also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. 

Merchant reserves the right to assign one coupon code to the Affiliate, with details and usage clarified on the program dashboard. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliate may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram, or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.


3. Commissions and payment

A sale is considered eligible for commission if the last click prior to purchase came via your affiliate link, with the click occurring inside the click window as defined by the Program. If the customer both clicks on the affiliate link and uses coupon code, you will not receive a double commission.

Commissions are calculated by applying the commission amount defined in your specific commission structure against the value of the prodct sold, excluding any extra fees such as tax, shipping, and any other fulfillment costs.

In order to receive your commission, you must specify payment details on the Settings tab of the Affiliate Program.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.


4. Marketing tool

We may share promotional media such as banners, logos or specific collections to you through the Marketing tool tab. 


5. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link. If a potential referral customer doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies, we are unable to track them and will not pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies length is referenced on the Program registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or uses the coupon.


6. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: service@joieuse.com.


Go forward and refer!

Thank you for joining our program.
